Count only telescopes with non-null bandwidth usage, with share over the total of such telescopes.

queries:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT o.lunarstage AS lunarstage, t.observstation AS observstation, t.bandusagepct AS bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
station_avg AS (
  SELECT lunarstage, observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY lunarstage, observstation
),
phase_avg AS (
  SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg) AS avg_bandwidth_usage
  FROM station_avg
  GROUP BY lunarstage
),
phase_cnt AS (
  SELECT lunarstage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY lunarstage
)
SELECT c.lunarstage,
       a.avg_bandwidth_usage,
       c.telescope_count,
       c.telescope_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched) AS share
FROM phase_cnt c
JOIN phase_avg a ON a.lunarstage IS c.lunarstage;
WITH station_stats AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
)
SELECT
  lunarstage,
  AVG(station_avg) AS avg_bandwidth_usage,
  COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) AS station_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) FROM station_stats) AS share_of_total
FROM station_stats
GROUP BY lunarstage;
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT t.telescregistry, t.observstation, t.bandusagepct, o.lunarstage
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
station_avg AS (
  SELECT observstation, lunarstage, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY observstation, lunarstage
),
phase_avg AS (
  SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg) AS avg_bandwidth_usage
  FROM station_avg
  GROUP BY lunarstage
),
phase_count AS (
  SELECT lunarstage, COUNT(DISTINCT telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY lunarstage
)
SELECT
  pc.lunarstage,
  pa.avg_bandwidth_usage,
  pc.telescope_count,
  pc.telescope_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT telescregistry) FROM matched) AS share
FROM phase_count pc
JOIN phase_avg pa ON pa.lunarstage IS pc.lunarstage;
WITH station AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg, COUNT(t.bandusagepct) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  WHERE t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
)
SELECT lunarstage,
       AVG(station_avg) AS avg_bandwidth_usage,
       SUM(cnt) AS telescope_count,
       SUM(cnt) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM station) AS share
FROM station
GROUP BY lunarstage;
